entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Ram Kewal Tripathi
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ramesh Sinha,J.
Hon'ble Narendra Kumar Johari,J.

Heard Shri Ram Kewal Tripathi, learned Counsel for the petitioners, Shri Pawan Kumar Mishra,
learned Additional Government Advocate for the State respondents no.1 and 2 and perused the impugned F.I.R. as well as material brought on record.

The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with a prayer to issue a writ of certiorari to quash the impugned FIR dated 30.01.2023 bearing FIR No.0004 of 2023, under Sections 308, 376,
323, 342, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Mahila Thana, District Balrampur; with a further prayer not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of the impugned FIR.

It has been contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that earlier the petitioner no.3 had lodged an FIR on 14.12.2022 bearing FIR No.0368 of 2022, under Sections 494, 504, 506, 120-B I.P.C. against respondent no.3, copy of which is annexed as Annexure No.3 to the petition, and in Jahagir Alam And Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

sentences.text:

1 retaliation the impugned FIR has been lodged against the petitioners with false and frivolous allegations, hence, the impugned FIR is liable to be quashed.
Learned Additional Government Advocate for the State-respondents, on the other hand, opposed the prayer for quashing of the FIR and states that the petitioners are named in the FIR.
He next argued that the complainant and petitioner no.1 are the teachers in the same Madarsa.
On 22.08.2022 when the complainant was going to her house, the petitioner no.1 stopped her and told that her father met with an accident and offered her to go along with him to the place of incident.
On believing him, the complainant went along with petitioner no.1, who took her to his room where she was raped by petitioner at the edge of knife.

After committing rape, the accused petitioner no.1 took her to his village on the motorcycle and on the way, the accused-petitioner no.1 pushed the complainant from his motorcycle, as a result of which the complainant sustained serious injuries and got unconscious.
The father and mother of the complainant along with villagers took her to the District Hospital, Balrampur.

After returning home, the complainant narrated the whole incident to her parents, upon which the father of the complainant made a complaint at police station on 02.09.2022, then the police brought the accused-petitioner no.1 to the police station and kept him there for three days, but the FIR was not lodged by the police.
The father and uncle of the complainant was being pressurized by the police to get the matter compromised and asked the complainant to solemnize marriage with the accused -petitioner no.1.
A compromise was written in the Police Station on 07.09.2022 and the complainant along with father and uncle went to the court.
After completion of the documentation, the complainant was sent to the house of the accused/petitioners, where the complainant was being harassed by the first wife and father of petitioner no.1.
The father of petitioner no.1 also committed rape upon the complainant and she was being tortured by them.
He further submits that from a perusal of F.I.R. cognizable offence is clearly made out against the petitioners, hence the present petition is liable to be dismissed.

Having examined the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties, perusing the impugned F.I.R., which clearly shows that cognizable offence is made out against the petitioners,
and considering the fact that specific allegation of committing rape upon the victim has been levelled upon the petitioners no.1 and 2, we are of the opinion that no interference is called for by this Court in its extraordinary power under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for quashing of the F.I.R. or for grant of any interim relief to the petitioners.

The petition lacks merit and is, accordingly, dismissed.
.
(Narendra Kumar Johari, J.) (Ramesh Sinha, J.) Order Date :- 23.3.2023
Anand Sri./-
